title: CT 105 (download-client): stop qBittorrent until it has a VPN
description:
Operator decision 2026-10-11: pause the download client now, then put it behind the AirVPN tunnel before it runs again.

Measured 2026-10-11: CT 105 (download-client, 192.168.1.24) has no VPN — interfaces lo and eth0 only, no /etc/wireguard, no wg-quick unit, default route via 192.168.1.1, and a global IPv6 address; qBittorrent (qbittorrent-nox.service, Web UI on 8080, torrent port 61661) sends its traffic on the operator's own connection (public IPv4 198.51.100.7). The AirVPN WireGuard config is stored in the engine as the secret AIRVPN_WG_CONF (Switzerland, ch3 entry3, UDP 1637). CT 105 is unprivileged (features: nesting=1).

Inside CT 105: stop qbittorrent-nox.service and disable it so it does not start again on a reboot before the tunnel exists. Change nothing else.

Done when `pct exec 105 -- systemctl is-active qbittorrent-nox` answers inactive and `pct exec 105 -- systemctl is-enabled qbittorrent-nox` answers disabled.
